title: Diagnostic Ultrasound — Tendons, Muscles, Fluid and Veins

hook.en: Ultrasound uses sound, not radiation, and can show a tendon move in real time. Learn what it shows well, how to read the words in a report and when it is the right first test.
hook.ur: Ultrasound radiation nahi, awaaz istemal karta hai, aur tendon ko harkat karte hue dikha sakta hai. Seekhein yeh kya achha dikhata hai, report ke alfaz kaise parhein aur yeh pehla sahi test kab hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain how ultrasound works, describe bright and dark (echogenic and anechoic) structures, say when ultrasound beats MRI or X-ray, and recognise report terms for tendon tears, tendinopathy, fluid and a clot in a vein.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke ultrasound kaise kaam karta hai, roshan aur kaali (echogenic aur anechoic) structures batayenge, kehenge ke ultrasound MRI ya X-ray se kab behtar hai, aur tendon tears, tendinopathy, fluid aur nas mein clot ke report alfaz pehchanenge.

text.en: A probe sends high-frequency sound into the body and listens for **echoes**. **Bone reflects almost all of the sound**, so it looks very bright with a dark **shadow** behind it. **Fluid lets sound pass and looks black** (anechoic). **Tendons look like fine bright parallel lines** (a fibrillar pattern) and **muscle looks like a mix of dark and bright streaks**. Ultrasound is **safe, quick, cheap and dynamic**: it can watch a tendon or a joint as the patient moves. It cannot see through bone or deep structures well, and **the result depends on the skill of the operator**.
text.ur: Probe tez frequency ki awaaz jism mein bhejta hai aur **goonj (echo)** sunta hai. **Haddi lagbhag sari awaaz wapas bhejti hai**, is liye bohat roshan nazar aati hai aur uske peechay kaala **saya** hota hai. **Paani awaaz guzarne deta hai aur kaala nazar aata hai** (anechoic). **Tendons baareek roshan barabar lines** (fibrillar pattern) jaise aur **muscle kaali aur roshan lakeeron ka mel** nazar aata hai. Ultrasound **mehfooz, tez, sasta aur dynamic** hai: mareez ke hilne par tendon ya joint ko dekh sakta hai. Yeh haddi ke peechay ya gehre structures ko achhi tarah nahi dekh sakta, aur **nateeja operator ki maharat par munhasir hai**.

text.en: Think of ultrasound as **a bat finding its way in the dark**. It sends out a sound and reads the echoes. A wall (bone) bounces everything back and leaves a silent shadow behind it; an open space (fluid) lets the sound through and looks empty. A skilled "bat" can tell a great deal, but a rushed or inexperienced one can miss the detail.
text.ur: Ultrasound ko **andhere mein raasta dhoondhta chamgadar** samjhein. Woh awaaz bhejta hai aur goonj parhta hai. Deewar (haddi) sab kuch wapas phenk deti hai aur peechay khamosh saya chhorti hai; khuli jagah (paani) awaaz guzarne deti hai aur khaali nazar aati hai. Maahir "chamgadar" bohat kuch bata sakta hai, magar jaldi karne wala ya na-tajurbakar tafseel miss kar sakta hai.

steps.title: Know the question
steps.detail: Check why the scan was done: a tendon or muscle injury, a swollen joint, a lump, or a swollen calf. The report answers that question first. || Sawal jaanein

steps.title: Learn the key words
steps.detail: "Hypoechoic" is darker than normal (swelling, a tear, fluid); "hyperechoic" is brighter (bone, scar, calcification); "anechoic" is black (clear fluid); "thickened" and "neovascularity" can be seen in tendinopathy; "partial" or "full-thickness tear" describes how deep a tear goes. || Aham alfaz seekhein

steps.title: Check what moved
steps.detail: Many reports note findings on dynamic testing, such as a tendon impinging under the bone when the arm is raised, or a tendon that slips out of its groove. These add information that a still scan cannot give. || Dekhein kya harkat hui

steps.title: Link it to the patient
steps.detail: Compare with symptoms and examination. Many tendons look abnormal in people without pain, so a finding matters when it matches the patient's pain, loading and function. || Mareez se jorein

text.en: **Sound, not radiation; skill matters.** Ultrasound is safe and shows movement, but the report is only as good as the operator. When the report and the patient disagree, ask for a second opinion or another test.
text.ur: **Awaaz, radiation nahi; maharat ahem.** Ultrasound mehfooz hai aur harkat dikhata hai, magar report utni hi achhi jitna operator. Report aur mareez mein farq ho to doosri raaye ya doosra test maangein.

text.en: **Treating every tendon change as the cause of pain.** Thickened or darker tendons are common in people with no pain, especially with age and sport. Use the scan with the loading history and the examination, and explain that tendons usually recover with progressive loading.
text.ur: **Har tendon ki tabdeeli ko dard ki wajah samajhna.** Mote ya kaale tendons bina dard wale logon mein aam hain, khaas kar umar aur khel ke saath. Scan ko loading ki history aur examination ke saath istemal karein, aur samjhayein ke tendons aam taur par darje war loading se theek ho jate hain.

text.en: **Use it to help the patient understand.** Showing a patient a tendon that moves normally on ultrasound can be reassuring, and a scan that shows a partial tear helps you plan loading. Always explain that the picture is one piece of the story, and keep the plan active.
text.ur: **Mareez ko samjhane mein istemal karein.** Mareez ko ultrasound par normal harkat karta tendon dikhana tasalli bakhsh ho sakta hai, aur partial tear dikhane wala scan loading ka plan banane mein madad deta hai. Hamesha samjhayein ke tasveer kahani ka ek hissa hai, aur plan active rakhein.

question.en: Why can ultrasound watch a tendon "in action" while MRI cannot?
question.ur: Ultrasound tendon ko "kaam karte hue" kyun dekh sakta hai jabke MRI nahi?

answer.en: Ultrasound produces live images, and the probe can be held on the skin while the patient moves. MRI needs the patient to lie still in a tube for many minutes and builds the picture over time. This is why a tendon snapping or impinging only on movement is best seen on ultrasound.
answer.ur: Ultrasound live tasveerein banata hai, aur mareez ke hilte waqt probe jild par rakha ja sakta hai. MRI mein mareez ko kai minute tube mein saakit letna parhta hai aur tasveer waqt ke saath banti hai. Isi liye sirf harkat par tendon ka snap ya phansna ultrasound par behtar nazar aata hai.

beats.patient: A 48-year-old painter has had three months of shoulder pain when lifting his arm overhead. The ultrasound report says "a partial-thickness tear of the supraspinatus with subacromial bursal thickening, dynamic impingement on abduction". Strength is good and he has full movement.
beats.assessment: A partial tear with good strength and range is common and often responds to a loading programme, so he does not need an urgent surgical referral.
beats.treatment: Explain the finding, start a graded shoulder strengthening plan, adjust overhead work and review in six weeks, referring if strength falls or pain stays high.
beats.reassess: At twelve weeks his pain is much less and he returns to full painting.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a suspected full-thickness tear after trauma with sudden weakness, an inability to lift the arm, a tendon rupture (such as Achilles) or a suspected clot in a leg vein, especially with chest pain or breathlessness. Ultrasound-guided injections are a medical decision; do not advise them yourself.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** trauma ke baad achanak kamzori ke saath mumkin full-thickness tear, bazu na utha pana, tendon ka phatna (maslan Achilles) ya pindli ki nas mein mumkin clot, khaas kar seene ke dard ya saans ki tangi ke saath. Ultrasound ki rehnumai wale injections medical faisla hain; khud mashwara na dein.

summary.en: Ultrasound uses sound to show soft tissue and movement without radiation; bone is bright with a shadow and fluid is black.
summary.ur: Ultrasound awaaz se narm tissue aur harkat radiation ke baghair dikhata hai; haddi roshan saye ke saath aur paani kaala.

summary.en: It is best for superficial tendons, muscles, fluid, nerves and clots in leg veins, but depends on the operator and cannot see through bone.
summary.ur: Yeh oopar ke tendons, muscles, paani, nerves aur pindli ki nason ke clots ke liye behtareen hai, magar operator par munhasir hai aur haddi ke peechay nahi dekh sakta.

summary.en: Match report findings to the patient: many tendon changes are common without pain.
summary.ur: Report ki findings ko mareez se milayein: tendon ki bohat si tabdeeliyan bina dard ke aam hain.
